name: The Average Everyday Adventures of Samantha Browne
source:
Samantha Browne has been waiting patiently in her room for everyone else to fall asleep, go out, or do whatever it is people who enjoy social interaction do. She's hungry. Okay, she's past hungry. She's at whatever stage is right after hungry. It's not that she doesn't have food, she has a box of oatmeal just sitting on her shelf waiting for her consumption. Thing is, she needs some help. Your help specifically and well, helping Sam isn't always easy.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/445130]Steam[/url]]
translation:
萨曼莎·布朗一直耐心地待在房间里，等所有人入睡、出门，或者去做社交达人会做的其他事情。她饿了。好吧，已经不只是饿了，而是进入了比饿更糟糕的阶段。她不是没有食物，架子上就放着一盒等她享用的燕麦片。问题是，她需要帮助。具体来说，需要你的帮助，而帮助萨姆并不总是容易。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/445130]Steam[/url]]
